llmJudgeRequirements.reason: preferencesAtom is created with atomWithStorage and createJSONStorage(() => AsyncStorage)
evidence: const preferencesAtom = atomWithStorage<Preferences>(STORAGE_KEY, SAFE_DEFAULT_PREFERENCES, createJSONStorage(() => AsyncStorage))

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Hydration completion is tracked in dedicated atom state
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: A dedicated useState boolean `hydrated` tracks hydration completion and is set to true after the async check resolves

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Preference-dependent content is gated behind a deterministic pre-hydration UI branch
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: The JSX renders preference-dependent content (theme, compact, toggle buttons) unconditionally without checking the `hydrated` flag; no loading/splash branch exists

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Hydration action runs first and profile loading is triggered only after hydration completes
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Profile fetch useEffect guards on `if (hydrated && !profile)`, ensuring it only runs after the hydration useEffect sets hydrated=true

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Post-hydration profile load fetches the users endpoint and builds preview text from `firstName` and `lastName`
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Fetches https://dummyjson.com/users/1 and maps data.firstName and data.lastName into profile state, which is rendered as '{profile.firstName} {profile.lastName}'

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Preference toggle actions update persisted state through functional atom updater paths
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Both toggleTheme and toggleCompact call setPreferences with a functional updater receiving `previous` and returning a new object
